title: Hedgehog holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q58 44 52 54' stroke='#e0e0e0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='20' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M64 35 l-3 4 6 0z' fill='#c9184a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='14' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- hedgehog body (spiny back) -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='70' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- spikes -->
  <g fill='#5c3a1a'>
    <path d='M18 62 l-5 -8 8 3z'/>
    <path d='M24 54 l-3 -10 8 6z'/>
    <path d='M33 50 l0 -11 6 8z'/>
    <path d='M43 49 l4 -10 4 10z'/>
    <path d='M53 53 l7 -8 1 10z'/>
    <path d='M59 61 l8 -5 -3 9z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- lighter spike highlights -->
  <g fill='#b07a45'>
    <path d='M22 58 l-3 -5 5 2z'/>
    <path d='M28 52 l-2 -6 5 4z'/>
    <path d='M37 48 l0 -7 4 5z'/>
    <path d='M47 48 l2 -6 3 6z'/>
    <path d='M55 54 l4 -5 0 7z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- face / snout -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='74' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#f2c48d'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='9' cy='76' r='3' fill='#3d2b1f'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='69' r='2.6' fill='#3d2b1f'/>
  <circle cx='22.8' cy='68.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='17' cy='81' r='3' fill='#ff9aa2' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='78' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='86' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#5c3a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#5c3a1a'/>
  <!-- raised paw holding balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='58' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5c3a1a' transform='rotate(-25 56 58)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='90' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#4a2e14'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='91' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#4a2e14'/>
</svg>
